them nil by mouth, therefore to maintain hydration and nutrition alternative feeding routes need to be explored through provision
of an enteral tube.
Mucositis and stomatitis
Mucositis and stomatitis arise as a consequence of treatment such as high dose chemotherapy, radiotherapy (including total body
irradiation) or infection.
If the mouth or throat is sore it can limit the physical ability to eat by affecting ability to chew and swallow. It can also affect taste.
Analgesia taken before eating and drinking can help ease the pain and enable the person to eat a little more.
Modifying the diet is also helpful (Table 7).
